meta.description: React / JSX / TSX / .jsx / .tsx 実装を書く前に、コンポーネント設計、Atomic Design を補助観点にした UI 分割、hooks、props、state、UI 実装の責務分離を確認するときに使う。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果写 React 组件前需要先理清结构和职责
copy.tagline_en: Review component design and UI decomposition before coding React
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to clarify component structure and responsibilities before writing React code

howto.what: Claude 在写 React 代码前，会先检查组件设计、UI 拆分、hooks、props、state 和职责分离，确保代码融入现有 UI。
howto.when: 当你要求编写 React/JSX/TSX 代码，或讨论组件设计、状态管理时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个用户列表组件，用 Atomic Design 拆分。
say.note: Claude 会先分析组件边界和职责。

say.text: 检查这个 React 组件的 props 是否合理。
say.note: Claude 会评估 props 的自然性和稳定性。

howto.what_en: Before writing React code, Claude checks component design, UI decomposition, hooks, props, state, and separation of concerns to ensure the code fits the existing UI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write React/JSX/TSX code or discuss component design or state management.

say_en.text: Design a user list component using Atomic Design.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze component boundaries and responsibilities first.

say_en.text: Check if this React component's props are reasonable.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate the naturalness and stability of props.
